claims.verbatim:
Liverpool, May 15—A barrel of oil, supposed kerosene
painted lead color, and marked "J. K." in red letters, was
picked up on the 18th[?] of April, in lat. 32[?] N, by the R. A. Al-
len, Farr, which in eight days afterwards passed a quantity
more of the same description. The R. A. Allen arrived here
from Mobile May 11.
